points.description: States that the alternative to solving a problem with recursive functions is iteration (the iterative approach), i.e. solving it by repeated steps/loops rather than by recursive function calls. Accept equivalent wording such as 'iteration', 'iterative method', 'using loops (for/while)', or equivalent Tamil wording like 'தொடர்ச்சியான செயலாக்கம்/சுழற்சி முறை'.

rubric.notes: Full marks are earned only by identifying iteration/iterative approach (or an equivalent loop-based method) as the alternative. No marks are earned for restating recursion or giving an unrelated method. Since the model answer is a single term, the whole 5 marks are attached to that identification.
